{{Otheruses|legendary weapon|the trait|Juggernaut}} {{Weapon infobox | uslot = Superior Sigil of Benevolence | type = Hammer | level = 80 | salvage = none | bound = account use | skin = The Juggernaut (skin); The Colossus (skin); Magmaton (skin); The Colossus Experiment (skin) | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | id = 30690 | gallery2 = The Juggernaut footfalls.jpg | gallery2-text = Quicksilver footfalls. }} [[The Juggernaut]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] hammer crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|A relic dating back to the age of the [[Great Giant|Giganticus Lupicus]], the Juggernaut may be a gift from the gods. When held by a worthy champion, they are cast in a solid sheet of quicksilver.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 The Colossus | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of The Juggernaut | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[The Juggernaut]] is a thermometer-like hammer with a golden atlas figurine and an inner tube containing the [[Vial of Quicksilver]] used to craft it. The quicksilver shifts in response to the player's swings. ;Aura * The user's body is coated in quicksilver. The color of the metal changes depending on: ** The dye on the user's armor ** The ambient light (specifically, the color of the reflection cubemap designated for the region of the map and time of day, and as a result, shadows and direct light sources by themselves do not affect the armor's effect) ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, quicksilver swirls around the user's body. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind drops of quicksilver. ;Skill effects * Swinging the weapon causes it to spill and splash quicksilver. * Default projectiles are replaced with globs of shiny quicksilver. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: [[Zealot's Embrace]] ** {{scrapper}} [[Scrapper]]: [[Grenade Barrage]] ** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: [[Hammer Bolt]] ** {{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: [[Citadel Bombardment]] ** {{catalyst}} [[Catalyst]]: [[Singeing Strike]], [[Wind Slam]], [[Flame Wheel]], [[Icy Coil]], [[Crescent Wind]], [[Rocky Loop]], [[Grand Finale]] === Gallery === File:The Juggernaut concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]].
